metadata.query: What happened on the Trail of Tears?

final_answer: The Trail of Tears, also known as the Indian Removal, was a series of forcible removals of Native American tribes in the southeastern United States from their ancestral lands between 1830 and 1850. The most infamous of these removals was the forced relocation of the Cherokee Nation from Georgia to Indian Territory (now Oklahoma) in 1838, a journey known as the Trail of Tears. (Sources: Encyclopedia Britannica, History.com)
